top_signals.title: Saudi Forces Strike Hodeidah Port as Houthis Warn Airlines Away From Airspace
top_signals.summary: The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said it had struck the Red Sea port of Hodeidah to destroy Houthi capabilities on Friday, as the militants warned airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, pledging new air strikes within hours.The developments…

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Drop for Third Week Straight
top_signals.summary: Oil prices fell on Friday and were set for a weekly decline on strong exports from the Middle East despite Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh and reports of tanker disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.Brent crude futures were down 67 cents, or 0.7%, at $91.31 a barrel at 1414 GMT.

top_signals.title: Tanker On Fire After Struck By Projectile Near Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: A tanker caught fire after being struck by an unknown projectile while sailing outbound through the Strait of Hormuz, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said on Friday.The British navy-affiliated agency UKMTO said that the incident occurred 8 nautical miles north of the Oman
